svg.title: 77b Supplier portal: Renew prequalification for 2027
svg.text: IDIU checks each one. You get a reminder 30 days before one expires.
Renew by Fri 20 Nov: sign this year's declaration; your other documents carry over.

g.text: Upload the 2027 licence when it is issued in January
Sign the 2027 declaration by Fri 20 Nov

svg.text: Busoga Tech Supplies Ltd · closes Fri 20 Nov 2026, 17:00

g.text: IDIU Procurement checks the renewal and the Executive Approver approves it, as for a new application. You
